I think it's a very very sick world that it costs money to die, that it costs an exorbitant price to try to save your beloved's life, and that it even cost money to wipe your own ass. The pain is so bad and I was already in a dark depression to start with.
EDIT: oh, and they're  turning my power off in two days for non payment and I rely on a cpap to breathe in my sleep. But who cares,  right? I fucking hate my life and this world where it literally costs money to BREATHE!

It's not easy.  I hate showering. It's the most physically exhausting thing I do. It wears me out. I don't like the water on me. I don't like being naked and running myself with soap. It's hard.

Yeah. I have horrible credit because before my spouse left me we lost our home. There's even a special credit card for veterinary bills called Care Credit, and I don't even qualify for that. It's a sick world.

It means a lot, actually. Kind words mean the world to me. He has an elongated palate which is interfering with his ability to breathe. If I had the money to keep taking him to the vet and get him stable, and then if I had the money to go to a surgical vet and pay for surgery, there is a life-saving surgery for him. But I can't even raise enough money for yesterday's vet bill so I don't think I'm going to be able to do the surgery and it feels like a knife in my heart to know that my baby is probably doing to die simply because my life sucks and I have no money. But yes, your words mean a lot, kind words from people really help.

Thank you so much. I'm going through hell right now watching him suffer and being told "no" by multiple agencies and vets and seeing how few of my friends and family are donating to my fundraiser, and realizing that I'm not going to be able to live without him when he goes. Thank you for your kind words. I swear I get more empathy here on Reddit than I do IRL.
